input.quote: 10.8 Headings; Counterparts. The section headings in this Agreement are for reference purposes only and shall not define, limit or affect the meaning or interpretation of this Agreement.
input.rationale: The Agreement has no insurance article: a search for "insurance" returns nothing, and the General Provisions (Section 10, paragraphs p0059-p0070) run from Notices through Headings/Counterparts with no coverage requirement. HDI is squarely a services/hosting vendor to us: it designs, develops, hosts, operates and maintains the Site on its own server (Sections 1.1, 1.3, 1.4), collects customer orders and processes our inventory data (Section 1.5), and expressly acknowledges access to our "Content, user information, data, knowledge and proprietary and trade secret information" as Confidential Information (Section 8.1). A vendor that hosts our storefront and processes consumer order and user data with no insurance backstop hits the playbook walk-away position, so we insert the standard coverage package (CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M, cyber/privacy USD 5M, statutory workers' compensation, certificates on request) as a new Section 10.9, placed at the end of the General Provisions where it is captured by the Section 10 survival language in Section 10.7. Fallback of E&O USD 1M and cyber USD 2M is available if HDI's program cannot reach the preferred limits.

proposal.summary: Insert a new Section 10.9 requiring HDI to carry commercial general liability, E&O, cyber and workers' compensation insurance, with certificates on request.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement contains no insurance requirement even though HDI designs, hosts and operates the Site and handles our Confidential Information, user information and order data, so we have added a standard insurance provision in the General Provisions (commercial general liability USD 1M/2M, errors and omissions USD 2M, cyber/privacy USD 5M, and statutory workers' compensation, with certificates on request). If HDI's existing program cannot reach these limits, we can accept E&O of USD 1,000,000 and cyber liability of USD 2,000,000 as a fallback.

ops.text: 10.9 Insurance. HDI shall maintain, at its own expense, throughout the term of this Agreement and for a period of one (1) year thereafter: (a) commercial general liability insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate; (b) professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000; (c) cyber liability insurance covering privacy, data security and network security of not less than USD 5,000,000, HDI processing Confidential Information, user information and data hereunder; and (d) workers' compensation insurance as required by applicable law. HDI shall provide the Company with certificates of insurance evidencing such coverage upon request.
